answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays according to an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service to accumulate durable weight. EigenTrust factorization, adjusted by reciprocity and transitive evidence, leaves freshly spawned Sybil identities with near-zero eigenvector centrality; even a walnut, juniper, or trellis of colluding accounts cannot gain sufficient influence to pass consensus before decay exposes them.
